headline: NHTSA investigates comma.ai driving tech after fatal crashes
summary: NHTSA is investigating comma.ai's hands-off driving technology following fatal crashes. TechCrunch reports the probe covers at least 2 fatal crashes, some involving 'forked' versions of Comma's software, while Ars Technica says federal regulators know of 5 crashes in which comma.ai-equipped cars hit slow or stopped vehicles.
